text: Hello, I'm Dr. Agent. Can you describe when the swelling in your right knee started and if it was preceded by any specific injury or activity? Also, does the joint feel hot or look red to the touch?

text: 18-month-old boy. The patient is brought in by his parents due to swelling in his right knee noticed after playing in the park. The parents report that there was no obvious injury or incident at the park that could have led to the swelling. Upon further questioning, the mother recalls that an uncle on her side of the family had similar problems, suggesting a possible genetic component.

speaker: Doctor
text: Does the swelling tend to occur after minor trauma, and has he ever experienced bleeding from his nose or gums? I would also like to know if his movements in the knee are painful or if he is refusing to bear weight on it.
